inputs.en: Whether to show the dropdown arrow

inputs.name: max
inputs.zh: 多选时最多能选中的数量

outputs.en: Value change event, used for two-way binding

outputs.name: change
outputs.zh: 值变化事件，携带触发来源与选项
outputs.en: Change event with trigger and option

outputs.name: popupVisibleChange
outputs.zh: 下拉面板展开状态变化
outputs.en: Popup visibility change

outputs.name: create
outputs.en: Emitted when a new option is created

outputs.name: clear
outputs.en: Emitted when the value is cleared

outputs.name: remove
outputs.type: { value: SelectValue; option?: SelectOptionObj; event: Event }
outputs.en: Emitted when a selected tag is removed

outputs.name: search
outputs.en: Emitted when the search keyword changes

outputs.name: focus

inputs.name: label
inputs.en: Tooltip label of the slider button

outputs.name: change
outputs.en: Emits when value changes

outputs.name: changeEnd
outputs.zh: 拖动结束或点击轨道时触发
outputs.en: Emits when dragging ends or rail is clicked

inputs.name: label
inputs.zh: 开关文字，传数组时第一项是选中态、第二项是未选中态
inputs.en: Label of the switch, an array means [on, off]

inputs.name: customValue
inputs.zh: 自定义开关值，`[选中值, 未选中值]`

inputs.name: beforeChange
inputs.zh: 切换前拦截，返回 false 或 resolve 为 false 时不切换
inputs.en: Callback before switching, return false to prevent it

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.zh: 值变化事件，用于双向绑定
outputs.en: Value change event, used for two-way binding

outputs.name: change
outputs.zh: 值变化事件，携带原始事件
outputs.en: Change event with the raw event

inputs.name: rowKey
inputs.en: Field name of the row key

inputs.name: hover
inputs.en: Whether to highlight the row on hover

inputs.name: height
inputs.zh: 表格高度，超出后内部滚动
inputs.en: Table height, scrolls inside when exceeded

inputs.name: maxHeight
inputs.zh: 表格最大高度，超出后内部滚动
inputs.en: Max table height, scrolls inside when exceeded

inputs.name: sort
inputs.zh: 受控排序，传入后表格不再本地排序
inputs.en: Controlled sort, the table stops sorting locally once provided

inputs.name: multipleSort
inputs.en: Whether multiple column sorting is allowed

inputs.name: filterValue
inputs.zh: 受控筛选值，传入后表格不再自己记录筛选状态
inputs.en: Controlled filter value, the table stops keeping filter state once provided

inputs.name: defaultFilterValue
inputs.zh: 默认筛选值，仅初始生效

inputs.name: selectedRowKeys
inputs.zh: 受控的选中行 key，传入后表格不再自己记录选中状态
inputs.en: Controlled selected row keys, the table stops keeping selection state once provided

inputs.name: defaultSelectedRowKeys
inputs.zh: 默认选中的行 key，仅初始生效
inputs.en: Default selected row keys, applied initially

inputs.name: indeterminateSelectedRowKeys
inputs.zh: 半选状态的行 key，用于表格外部控制半选

inputs.name: rowSelectionAllowUncheck
inputs.zh: 单选时是否允许再次点击取消选中
inputs.en: Whether clicking a selected row again deselects it in single mode

inputs.name: selectOnRowClick
inputs.en: Whether clicking a row selects it

inputs.name: expandedRowKeys
inputs.zh: 受控的展开行 key，传入后表格不再自己记录展开状态
inputs.en: Controlled expanded row keys, the table stops keeping expand state once provided

inputs.name: defaultExpandedRowKeys
inputs.zh: 默认展开的行 key，仅初始生效
inputs.en: Default expanded row keys, applied initially

inputs.name: expandOnRowClick
inputs.zh: 点击行时展开 / 收起该行
inputs.en: Whether clicking a row toggles its expanded state

inputs.name: expandIcon
inputs.en: Whether to show the expand icon column

inputs.name: pagination
inputs.zh: 分页配置，传入后表格底部显示分页；数据超过一页且未开启 disableDataPage 时自动本地分页
inputs.en: Pagination config; the table renders a pager and paginates locally unless disableDataPage is on

inputs.name: disableDataPage
inputs.zh: 关闭本地分页，只显示分页器并把翻页事件交给使用方（服务端分页）
inputs.en: Disable local pagination, only render the pager and emit page changes (server-side paging)

inputs.name: rowspanAndColspan
inputs.zh: 合并单元格回调，返回 `{ rowspan, colspan }` 与相邻单元格合并
inputs.en: Merge cells by returning `{ rowspan, colspan }` for the target cell

inputs.name: scroll
inputs.zh: 虚拟滚动配置，`type: 'virtual'` 且行数超过 `threshold` 时只渲染可视区域的行
inputs.en: Virtual scroll config; only visible rows are rendered when `type` is `virtual` and rows exceed `threshold`

inputs.name: resizable
inputs.zh: 是否允许拖拽表头调整列宽，单列可以用 `resizable: false` 关闭
inputs.en: Whether column widths can be adjusted by dragging the header edge

outputs.name: sortChange
outputs.en: Emitted when the sort changes

outputs.name: filterChange
outputs.zh: 筛选变化，表格本身不改变数据，需要在使用方自行过滤
outputs.en: Emitted when the filter changes, filter the data yourself

outputs.name: selectChange
outputs.en: Emitted when the selected rows change

outputs.name: expandChange
outputs.en: Emitted when the expanded rows change

outputs.name: pageChange
outputs.zh: 分页变化，携带新一页的数据
outputs.en: Emitted when the page changes, with the new page data

outputs.name: columnResizeChange
outputs.zh: 列宽拖拽结束，携带拖拽后的列宽
outputs.en: Emitted after a column resize drag ends

inputs.name: value
inputs.zh: 选项卡值，未声明时使用所在位置的下标
inputs.en: Tab value, defaults to the panel index

inputs.name: removable
inputs.en: Whether to show the close icon

inputs.name: draggable
inputs.zh: 是否允许拖拽排序（配合 t-tabs 的 dragSort）
inputs.en: Whether this tab can be dragged

inputs.name: lazy
inputs.zh: 是否在首次激活时才渲染内容
inputs.en: Whether to render the content on first activation

inputs.name: destroyOnHide
inputs.zh: 是否在隐藏时销毁内容
inputs.en: Whether to destroy the content when hidden

inputs.name: addable
inputs.en: Whether to show the add button

inputs.name: dragSort
inputs.zh: 是否开启拖拽排序，排序结果由 (dragSortChange) 抛给使用方
inputs.en: Whether tabs can be dragged to sort

inputs.name: scrollPosition
inputs.zh: 激活选项卡滚入可视区时的对齐方式
inputs.en: Alignment used when scrolling the active tab into view

inputs.name: value
inputs.zh: 当前激活的选项卡值，受控时以它为准

outputs.name: change
outputs.zh: 激活选项卡变化时触发
outputs.en: Emits when the active tab changes

outputs.name: add
outputs.en: Emits when the add button is clicked

outputs.name: remove
outputs.zh: 点击页签关闭按钮时触发
outputs.en: Emits when a tab close icon is clicked

outputs.name: dragSortChange
outputs.zh: 拖拽排序时触发，使用方按 payload 重排自己的面板数据
outputs.en: Emits when tabs are dropped at a new position

inputs.name: maxWidth
inputs.zh: 文字最大宽度，超出省略
inputs.en: Max width of the text, truncated when exceeded

inputs.name: color
inputs.zh: 自定义颜色，会按亮度自动选择文字颜色
inputs.en: Custom color, the text color is chosen by luminance

inputs.name: title
inputs.zh: title 提示，false 关闭、true 使用文字内容
inputs.en: Title tooltip, false disables it and true uses the content

outputs.name: close
outputs.en: Emitted when the close icon is clicked

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.zh: 是否根据内容自动撑高，可传 `{ minRows, maxRows }`
inputs.en: Whether to grow with the content

inputs.name: maxcharacter
inputs.zh: 最大字符数，按字符（而非字节）计算，超出时截断

inputs.name: maxlength
inputs.zh: 原生 maxlength，超出时浏览器直接阻止输入

inputs.name: allowInputOverMax
inputs.zh: 是否允许输入超过最大字符数
inputs.en: Whether input over the maximum is allowed

inputs.name: tips
inputs.zh: 输入框下方的提示文字

inputs.zh: 自动消失的毫秒数，0 表示不自动消失
